result.summary: Wrote s807/r3/lit.md covering the four literature topics from r3/analysis.md §5 (L1: realized-variance soft-power aggregation / semivariance; L2: day_distinct_ratio(Volume) thin-trading flag vs. known liquidity measures; L3: 5-day signed persistence vs. return-sign streaks and turnover-conditional momentum/reversal; L4: nominal price level and the sign-conflicting price heads). Each topic lists concrete operator-language translations of how the literature constructs/treats similar structures, each tagged with a numbered source. 20 references compiled with title/authors/year-month/venue/link/verified flag (19 verified true via search snippets or direct fetch of the source, 1 marked false since only a secondary description of Kyle 1985 was seen). Several sub-questions (A-share conditional sorts by listing age/board, realized-variance-relative-to-own-history, event-aligned reversal windows, tick/lot-size paper whose date couldn't be confirmed after a 403, a possibly-post-cutoff 2023 FRL paper) are explicitly marked as not found / not usable rather than fabricated, both inline per topic and in a trailing "没有用上的线索" section. Only read files permitted under the task's read list (PLAN.md §1–2, and the s807 directory); wrote only the required lit.md via the Write tool (succeeded, no Bash-heredoc fallback needed) and confirmed with ls -l.
